log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Dragapult+Incineroar lead: Fake Out stops Prankster screens, Dragapult outspeeds all and OHKOs Garchomp with Draco Meteor. Kingambit back punishes double Intimidate (Arcanine/Mawile) with Defiant, Iron Head 2HKOes Grimmsnarl. Serperior provides Taunt to shut down screens mid-game, Glare speed control, and Contrary Leaf Storm snowball. Covers all six opponent threats.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp. They have double Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile), Prankster screens (Grimmsnarl), and Garchomp as fast offense. No hazard removal — Ceaseless Edge Spikes stick. Empoleon has Competitive to punish our Intimidate/Parting Shot. Slowbro is Regenerator bulky Water. Mawile carries Passho Berry (Water resist). Key: Fake Out beats Prankster screens, Defiant punishes Intimidate, Dragapult 209 Speed outspeeds entire team.

decisions.rationale: Lead twin Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile) to blunt Incineroar/Kingambit physical core; Mawile is immune to Dragapult's Dragon. Back Grimmsnarl for Prankster screens/Taunt and Empoleon (Steel) to wall Mega Gardevoir and Fighting-types.
decisions.notebook: Opponent is Dark/Fighting-physical heavy with Mega Gardevoir special wincon and Incineroar+Dragapult pivot lead (U-turn/Parting Shot tempo). Lead twin Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile) to blunt physical core; Mawile immune to Dragon (Dragapult). Back Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens/Taunt vs Serperior/Samurott) + Empoleon (Chople/Steel walls Gardevoir+Fighting). Slowbro (Leftovers) and Garchomp (Expert Belt) bench as cleaners: Slowbro Focus Blast vs Kingambit, Garchomp Ground/Rock/Dragon coverage. Bench Mega Gengar (Dark coverage punishes Ghost).

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Mawile denies its Play Rough (38-74% SE on Dragapult). Draco Meteor hits Arcanine for 50-92%, forcing Sitrus or putting it in KO range. Dragapult takes -2 SpA but can U-turn pivot next turn. Arcanine's free Snarl only does 21-38% to Dragapult and NVE to Incineroar. Strong offensive opener.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp. Double Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile), Prankster screens (Grimmsnarl), Garchomp fast offense. Empoleon Competitive punishes our Intimidate/Parting Shot. Slowbro Regenerator. Mawile Passho Berry. No hazard removal — Ceaseless Edge Spikes stick. Dragapult 209 Speed outspeeds entire team. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar Fake Out (+3) flinches one of us, so protecting one mon just lets the other be flinched for zero output—both attacking guarantees a hit. Dragapult is the faster special threat and Mawile is Dragon-immune, so we double it: Arcanine Snarl spreads (2x on Dragapult + SpA drop, robust vs U-turn) and Mawile Play Rough (2x Fairy). No opponent attack OHKOs (Draco 46-68%, Shadow Ball 28-88%, Flare Blitz ≤59%).
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Dark/Fighting-physical core + Mega Gardevoir special wincon; Incineroar+Dragapult pivot lead (Fake Out / U-turn / Parting Shot tempo). Twin Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile) blunts physical; Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult. Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens/Taunt) + Empoleon (Chople/Steel, Competitive) cover Gardevoir/Fighting. Cleaners: Slowbro Focus Blast vs Kingambit, Garchomp Ground/Rock/Dragon; Mega Gengar Dark coverage vs Ghost. Plan: vs Fake Out leads, double-attack the faster special threat rather than protect-one (zero output).

decisions.rationale: Double pivot out of -3 SpA Dragapult and -2 Atk Incineroar. Dragapult U-turns first (209 Speed) into Arcanine for chip then safely brings Kingambit; Incineroar Parting Shots Mawile to neuter its Brick Break (4x into Kingambit) and Play Rough, then brings Serperior. Arcanine's Snarl is 0.25x into Kingambit and 0.5x into Incineroar, so the pivot is safe. Kingambit+Serperior threaten both foes next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp. Double Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile), Prankster screens (Grimmsnarl), Garchomp fast offense. Empoleon Competitive punishes our Intimidate/Parting Shot. Slowbro Regenerator. Mawile Passho Berry. No hazard removal — Ceaseless Edge Spikes stick. Dragapult 209 Speed outspeeds entire team. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate. Turn 1: double Intimidate trades left both sides at -2 Atk; Dragapult -3 SpA from Draco Meteor+Snarl. Pivoted to Kingambit+Serperior turn 2.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit blanketed: resists Snarl/Play Rough, Defiant converts any foe stat drop into +2 Atk, and blackglasses Kowtow cleaves Arcanine neutrally. Serperior is also Fire-weak and walled by both current foes. Incineroar stays to preserve Intimidate pressure and Parting Shot pivot next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp. Double Intimidate (Arc+Maw), Prankster screens (Grimm), Garchomp fast. Empoleon Competitive punishes stat drops. Slowbro Regenerator. Mawile Passho Berry. No removal — Ceaseless Edge Spikes stick. Dragapult 209 outspeeds all. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate/stat drops. Serperior Contrary reverses Snarl/Intimidate into boosts. Turn 2 U-turn pivoted Dragapult→Kingambit; Incineroar stayed. Both foes at -1 Atk, Arc Sitrus consumed, Maw Passho intact.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult resists Flamethrower (0.5x) while Serperior risks OHKO (46-108%). Dragapult at 209 Speed outspeeds both foes, can U-turn next turn to reset -3 SpA drops, and doesn't share Kingambit's Fire weakness. Kingambit stays to preserve +2 Atk and can Protect next turn to scout or avoid the Flamethrower+BrickBreak double-up.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Arcanine/Mawile +2 of Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp. Double Intimidate (Arc+Maw), potential Prankster screens (Grimm), Garchomp fast, Empoleon Competitive. Dragapult 209 outspeeds all. Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate/stat drops. Serperior Contrary reverses Snarl into boosts but Fire-weak. Dragapult resists Fire, weak to Fairy. Kingambit 4x weak to Fighting (Mawile BrickBreak). No removal — hazards stick. Both foes debuffed: Arc -1 Atk, Maw -2 Atk/-1 SpA. Arc Sitrus consumed, Maw Passho intact.

decisions.rationale: Double the weakened special threat Dragapult: Arcanine Snarl (2x, spread also chips Incineroar) + Mawile Play Rough (2x). Combined 39-96% can KO the 65% Dragapult; if it U-turns/Protects, Snarl still hits Incineroar. Mawile survives Incineroar's Flare Blitz (Atk -2). Avoids zero-output Protect.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Dark/Fighting-physical core + Mega Gardevoir special wincon; Incineroar+Dragapult pivot lead (Fake Out / U-turn / Parting Shot tempo). Twin Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile) blunts physical; Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult. Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens/Taunt) + Empoleon (Chople/Steel, Competitive) cover Gardevoir/Fighting. Cleaners: Slowbro Focus Blast vs Kingambit, Garchomp Ground/Rock/Dragon; Mega Gengar Dark coverage vs Ghost. Plan: vs Fake Out leads, double the faster special threat (Dragapult) with Arcanine Snarl (spread, 2x) + Mawile Play Rough (2x); Snarl's spread still chips Incineroar if Dragapult U-turns/Protects. Mawile survives Incineroar Flare Blitz (2x but Atk -2).

decisions.rationale: Kingambit Kowtow Cleave OHKOs Arcanine (90-169% into 62% = guaranteed). Dragapult Shadow Ball into Mawile (52-110%) threatens KO or leaves it heavily damaged. Dragapult outspeeds all, so Shadow Ball lands before any foe move. Even if Mawile survives and Play Rough KOs Dragapult (29-57% into 56%), we trade 1-for-1 at worst while removing Arcanine. Incineroar and Serperior in back clean up.

Incineroar brings Intimidate to further cripple Mawile (-3 Atk) and Fake Out pressure on the opponent's fresh switch-in. Dragapult stays despite -3 SpA; Shadow Ball still threatens Mawile (20-45% range, possible KO at 22%). Incineroar can Parting Shot pivot later. Serperior risks Play Rough OHKO and doesn't provide immediate board impact.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Double Intimidate foes (Arc+Maw). Kingambit Defiant punished drops but fainted. Dragapult -3 SpA/-1 Atk, still outspeeds all. Incineroar can re-Intimidate on switch-in. Opponent has 2 of Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp unrevealed. Empoleon Competitive threatens if Intimidate triggers. Garchomp fast (134-169), threatens Dragapult with Dragon Claw. No weather/terrain set.

decisions.rationale: Double Kingambit: Flamethrower (2x) + Brick Break (4x) is the only KO path and targets the bigger threat (Defiant +2 Atk sweeper). Snarl is banned (lowers SpA -> Defiant Atk +2). Dragapult is weakened (SpA -3) and Flamethrower is 0.5x there, so not worth splitting. If Kingambit attacks, both hits land; even a non-KO leaves it badly hurt.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Dark/Fighting-physical core + Mega Gardevoir special wincon; Incineroar+Dragapult pivot lead. Kingambit Defiant triggers on ANY stat drop (incl. Snarl SpA) -> never Snarl it; at +2 Atk it is the prime physical threat. Flamethrower(2x)+Brick Break(4x) ~coin-flip KO from 84%. Dragapult after Draco Meteor self-drop + Snarl sits at SpA -3, weakened; Mawile Play Rough (2x) only 22.6-41.7% from 56% (not a clean KO). Twin Intimidate (Arcanine+Mawile) blunts physical; Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult. Empoleon (Chople/Competitive) + Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens) cover Gardevoir/Fighting. Plan: remove Kingambit, then handle Gardevoir with Empoleon/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Mawile can only pass and will likely be KO'd by Dragapult's Shadow Ball (Life Orb recoil also drops Dragapult to ~36%). Switching in Grimmsnarl hard-walls the likely Mega Gardevoir wincon (Dark immune to Psychic, Fairy resists Pixilate) and provides Prankster screens/Taunt. It also walls Dragapult (immune to Dragon) and survives its weakened hit. Empoleon stays benched as the damage dealer.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought 4: Incineroar (Intimidate/FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; KowtowCleave/SuckerPunch/IronHead/Protect), and one of Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate; HyperVoice/Psychic/WillOWisp/Protect), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect), Samurott-Hisui (Sharpness/FocusSash; CeaselessEdge/AquaCutter/SacredSword/Protect). Kingambit Defiant triggers on ANY stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it; at +2 Atk it is the prime physical threat. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult; Play Rough 2x but weak after Intimidate (cannot KO from 46%). Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar super-effective, Chople/Competitive. Plan: remove Kingambit, then wall Gardevoir with Grimmsnarl + damage with Empoleon.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Grimmsnarl (+3 priority) prevents Prankster screens this turn. Dragapult outspeeds Mawile and U-turns into Grimmsnarl (neutral, chip ~11-22%), then safely pivots to Serperior. Mawile's Play Rough (if it attacks) hits Serperior for only 9-20% neutral instead of 28-42% SE into Dragapult. Next turn Serperior threatens Leaf Storm/Glare while Incineroar can Parting Shot or Flare Blitz Mawile for a likely KO.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Double Intimidate foes (Arc+Maw). Kingambit Defiant punished drops but fainted. Dragapult -3 SpA/-1 Atk, still outspeeds all. Incineroar can re-Intimidate on switch-in. Opponent has 2 of Empoleon/Slowbro/Grimmsnarl/Garchomp unrevealed. Empoleon Competitive threatens if Intimidate triggers. Garchomp fast (134-169), threatens Dragapult with Dragon Claw. No weather/terrain set. Grimmsnarl Prankster status fails vs Dark types (Incineroar). Mawile has Passho Berry (water resist). Serperior contrary Leaf Storm boosts +2 SpA per use.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Mawile)
decisions.rationale: Mawile at 23% with -3 Atk is dead weight and gets Flare-Blitz KO'd; switching to healthy Empoleon (resists Fire/Dragon, Ice Beam 2x into Dragapult, survives both foes' hits per estimates) is clearly better. Grimmsnarl sets Light Screen to blunt Dragapult's special hits and future special win-cons (Gardevoir/Serperior) while it walls them itself.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought 4: Incineroar (Intimidate/FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; KowtowCleave/SuckerPunch/IronHead/Protect — fainted G1), and one of Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate; HyperVoice/Psychic/WillOWisp/Protect), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect), Samurott-Hisui (Sharpness/FocusSash; CeaselessEdge/AquaCutter/SacredSword/Protect). Kingambit Defiant triggers on ANY stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult; Play Rough 2x but weak after Intimidate. Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar 2x, Chople/Competitive. Plan: remove Kingambit, then wall Gardevoir with Grimmsnarl + damage with Empoleon.

decisions.rationale: Serperior Leaf Storm Empoleon: guaranteed +2 SpA boost even if Grimmsnarl Taunts/LightScreens first (Leaf Storm is an attack, ignores Taunt). Incineroar Parting Shot Grimmsnarl: pivots to Dragapult while stacking Atk debuff to -2. Empoleon Ice Beam won't OHKO Serperior; next turn +2 SpA Serperior + Dragapult threaten both foes. Avoiding Competitive trigger on Empoleon is critical.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Double Intimidate foes (Arc+Maw). Kingambit Defiant punished drops but fainted. Dragapult Life Orb Timid, outspeeds all visible. Incineroar Careful sitrusberry, can re-Intimidate on switch. Opponent brought Empoleon/Grimmsnarl/Mawile/Arcanine. Empoleon Competitive threatens +2 SpA if Intimidate/PartingShot hits it. Grimmsnarl Prankster + LightClay screens dangerous. Mawile has PasshoBerry. No weather/terrain set. Serperior Contrary LeafStorm = +2 SpA per use, key win condition.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Empoleon)
decisions.rationale: Light Screen (Prankster) halves Serperior's LeafStorm and Dragapult's special hits, keeping fragile Grimmsnarl alive (a LeafStorm would otherwise nearly KO it). Empoleon Ice Beam super-effectively chips the Contrary Serperior, the key ramp threat, and also 2x-KOs Dragapult if it pivots in. Neither foe hits super-effectively, so we safely set screens and pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought 4: Incineroar (Intimidate; FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; KowtowCleave/SuckerPunch/IronHead/Protect, fainted G1), and one of Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate; HyperVoice/Psychic/WillOWisp/Protect), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect), Samurott-Hisui (Sharpness/FocusSash; CeaselessEdge/AquaCutter/SacredSword/Protect). Kingambit Defiant triggers on ANY stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult; Play Rough 2x but weak after Intimidate. Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar 2x, Chople/Competitive. Serperior Contrary turns LeafStorm into a +2 SpA boost each use — pressure with Ice Beam (2x) and screen its special damage. Plan: remove Kingambit, then wall Gardevoir with Grimmsnarl + damage with Empoleon.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult U-turns Grimmsnarl to escape Ice Beam KO, pivots to Incineroar. Serperior Leaf Storms Empoleon — 20% thaw chance for 38–69% chip before Empoleon moves. Incineroar eats Ice Beam (14–32% even at +2 Competitive). Dragapult preserved in back; Incineroar threatens Fake Out + Flare Blitz next turn. Accept Competitive trigger as unavoidable cost of saving Dragapult.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Double Intimidate foes (Arc+Maw). Kingambit fainted. Dragapult Life Orb Timid 209 Spe outspeeds all. Incineroar Careful sitrusberry. Serperior Contrary LeafStorm = +2 SpA per use, key wincon but currently frozen. Opponent: Empoleon Competitive (triggers on Intimidate/PartingShot), Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay screens, Mawile PasshoBerry. No weather/terrain. Empoleon Ice Beam OHKOs Dragapult and Serperior. Incineroar Flare Blitz does 35–78% to Empoleon (neutral: Fire 0.5x Water × 2x Steel). Light Screen on foe side, 7 turns remain. Avoid switching Incineroar into Empoleon when avoidable to prevent Competitive snowball.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Grimmsnarl Taunt (Prankster +1) resolves first and denies Dragapult Protect, forcing it to attack or U-turn so Empoleon's Ice Beam (2x) lands. Dragapult is at 36% and frail; Ice Beam likely KOs or chips hard. Serperior is frozen and not an immediate threat. Removing or forcing out Dragapult keeps us ahead vs Incineroar + frozen Serperior.
decisions.notebook: Opponent G1 team confirmed: Incineroar (Intimidate; FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; fainted), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect). Gardevoir-Mega & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought. Kingambit Defiant triggers on any stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult. Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar 2x, Chople/Competitive. Serperior Contrary: LeafStorm = +2 SpA each use; pressure with Ice Beam (2x) + screens. Dragapult frail but Ice Beam not reliable OHKO (36-69%). Plan: Taunt Dragapult to deny Protect, Ice Beam it; then clean Serperior (Ice Beam 2x) and Incineroar (Empoleon 2x).

decisions.rationale: Serperior Leaf Storm into 32% Empoleon through Light Screen always KOs (57.1% min > 32%), removing the Ice Beam threat before Empoleon can move. Serperior hits +6 SpA. Incineroar cannot Fake Out (not its first turn on field), so it Flare Blitzes Grimmsnarl for chip. Grimmsnarl's Prankster Taunt on Serperior does not stop Leaf Storm.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Serperior Contrary LeafStorm is primary win condition. Empoleon Competitive ChopleBerry Calm; Ice Beam OHKOs Serperior and Dragapult. Light Screen on foe side (set turn 5, ~6 turns remain). Incineroar Fake Out only works on first turn after switch-in (entered turn 6, so fails turn 7). Dragapult Taunt-locked, can only use attacking moves. After Empoleon faints, Mawile (22%, PasshoBerry, Intimidate) enters. Serperior at +6 threatens all remaining foes.

decisions.rationale: Empoleon Ice Beam is a guaranteed KO on Serperior (53%) if it acts, but Serperior outspeeds Empoleon (146-181 vs 80) and its +4 Leaf Storm is a guaranteed KO on Empoleon even through screens. Our only win path is Serperior targeting Grimmsnarl; Taunt denies its Protect and supports the hit. Best (only) chance to flip G1; HP resets next game anyway.
decisions.notebook: Opponent G1 team confirmed: Incineroar (Intimidate; FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; fainted), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect). Gardevoir-Mega & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought. Kingambit Defiant triggers on any stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult. Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar 2x, Chople/Competitive. Serperior Contrary: LeafStorm = +2 SpA each use; at +4 SpA its Leaf Storm is a GUARANTEED KO on Empoleon (even through both screens) and Serperior OUTSPEEDS Empoleon (146-181 vs 80), so Empoleon can never safely Ice Beam Serperior — must Protect/switch Empoleon when Serperior is up with +SpA. Empoleon Ice Beam is a guaranteed KO on Serperior (even 53% HP) only if Empoleon acts first. Dragapult frail but Ice Beam not reliable OHKO (36-69%). Plan vs this team: keep Empoleon away from Serperior's faster Leaf Storm; use Grimmsnarl Taunt/Reflect + Mawile (Dragon-immune) to wall Dragapult, then clean up.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Serperior +6 Leaf Storm OHKOs 10% Grimmsnarl through Light Screen (95% min). Incineroar -1 Flare Blitz OHKOs 22% Mawile (54.8% min). Both guaranteed KOs if they don't Protect. Even if one Protects, the other faints and we clean up next turn with no threat: Mawile can't OHKO either of ours, and Grimmsnarl has no damaging moves. Double KO attempt ends the game now.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Serperior Contrary LeafStorm is primary win condition. Opponent brought Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Grimmsnarl. Light Screen from Prankster Grimmsnarl halves special damage for their side. Empoleon Competitive ChopleBerry Calm with Ice Beam threatens Serperior and Dragapult but is now fainted. Mawile PasshoBerry Intimidate Impish. Grimmsnarl LightClay Prankster with no attacking moves. We are in commanding position with +6 Serperior.

decisions.rationale: Game 1 is lost: Grimmsnarl 11% and Mawile 23% vs Incineroar 62% + Serperior 59% (+6 SpA, Taunted→must Leaf Storm) + benched Dragapult 26%. Engine confirms Serperior Leaf Storm is a guaranteed KO on Grimmsnarl (84.7-162.9%) and Incineroar Flare Blitz a guaranteed KO on Mawile (47.1-84.1%, Fire 2x into Steel here). Grimmsnarl must Protect or die for nothing; Mawile dies regardless, so it chips Incineroar with 2x Brick Break (19.8-43.5%, no KO). No winning line exists.
decisions.notebook: Opponent G1 team: Incineroar (Intimidate; FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult (LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/BlackGlasses; fainted G1), Serperior (Contrary; LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect). Gardevoir-Mega & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought G1. FORMAT QUIRK: Fire is super-effective into Steel (Flare Blitz 2x into Mawile) — keep Mawile off Incineroar Fire or Protect it. Kingambit Defiant triggers on any stat drop incl Snarl SpA — never Snarl it. Mawile Dragon-immune walls Dragapult (immune Draco Meteor, resists Shadow Ball). Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) hard-walls Mega Gardevoir (immune Psychic, resists Pixilate Fairy) and resists Incineroar Dark; Empoleon (Water/Steel) resists Fire/Dragon, hits Incineroar 2x, Chople/Competitive. Serperior Contrary: LeafStorm = +2 SpA each use; at +SpA it OUTSPEEDS Empoleon (146-181 vs 80) and is a guaranteed KO on Empoleon even through both screens — must Protect/switch Empoleon when Serperior is up with +SpA. Dragapult frail but Ice Beam not reliable OHKO (36-69%). Serperior Leaf Storm 90% acc. Plan: keep Empoleon away from Serperior's faster Leaf Storm; use Grimmsnarl Taunt/Reflect + Mawile (Dragon-immune) to wall Dragapult, then clean up.

decisions.rationale: Serperior +6 Leaf Storm OHKOs Grimmsnarl through Light Screen (min 95% vs 10% HP). Incineroar Flare Blitz adds KO insurance. Even if consecutive Protect succeeds (33%), Grimmsnarl has no attacks and we win next turn. Simple and safe.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Serperior Contrary LeafStorm is primary win condition. Opponent brought Arcanine/Mawile/Empoleon/Grimmsnarl. Light Screen from Prankster Grimmsnarl halves special damage for their side. Empoleon Competitive ChopleBerry Calm with Ice Beam threatens Serperior and Dragapult but is now fainted. Mawile PasshoBerry Intimidate Impish. Grimmsnarl LightClay Prankster with no attacking moves (Light Screen, Reflect, Taunt, Protect). We are in commanding position with +6 Serperior. Game nearly won.

decisions.rationale: Game 1 is unwinnable: only Grimmsnarl (11% HP) remains alive versus 3 opponent Pokémon (Incineroar 56%, Serperior 64% with +6 SpA, Dragapult 26%). Serperior is Taunt-locked to Leaf Storm and its +6 SpA hit KOs Grimmsnarl through Light Screen regardless. Cannot faint 3 foes with one 11% mon, so forfeit and reset for G2/G3.
decisions.notebook: Opp G1 team: Incineroar(Intimidate;FakeOut/PartingShot/FlareBlitz/ThroatChop), Dragapult(LifeOrb/Infiltrator/Timid;ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Uturn/Protect), Kingambit(Defiant/BlackGlasses;fainted G1), Serperior(Contrary;LeafStorm/Taunt/Glare/Protect). Gardevoir-Mega & Samurott-Hisui NOT brought G1 — expect them G2/G3. FORMAT QUIRK: Fire 2x into Steel (FlareBlitz 2x Mawile) — keep Mawile off Incineroar Fire or Protect.
